title_en: 3+1 apartment for sale, at the end of May 5 street!
description_en: At the end of the 5 Maji street, we are selling a 3+1 apartment! The apartment is located on the 3rd residential floor and has an area of ​​107 m2. It is organized by a living room with a common kitchen, three bedrooms, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The apartment is ready for living. For a visit to the property or more information, contact us!
